calibration_probability_fit: maximum detector-pattern likelihood over a fixed p grid with known composition family; no logical labels
oracle_selection: Choose the decoder with minimum residual errors on validation data for each test condition; test is untouched.
specialist_usefulness_gate: Proceed to detector selector only if at least one specialist has lower test residuals than fixed nominal matching, exact paired McNemar p<0.05 after Bonferroni over 24 specialist-condition comparisons, and a seed-bootstrap 95% interval of the error-rate difference below zero.
dem_approximation: Stim detector_error_model(decompose_errors=True, approximate_disjoint_errors=True) for multi-component Pauli channels.
raw_data: Compressed NPZ per seed; calibration/validation/test detector arrays and observable labels retained for audit. Labels are evaluation-only.
